Subject: Renewal/Expansion - pricing follow-up & volume step-ups

Hi Jenna -

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we keep momentum:

- Current subscription: Hosted API, single-route gen model; ~40M tokens/mo baseline.
- Renewal timing: July 1 renewal for base subscription; you mentioned expansion needs starting in Q3.
- Expansion ask: add embeddings route for search + an additional gen route for product documentation assistant.
- Key procurement requirements: target blended unit economics, clear $/1M tokens target, and predictable step-up pricing for growth.

Could you confirm the expected token trajectories (month-by-month if available) and the internal budget range you're comfortable with for the new usage? You mentioned a target range for pricing per 1M tokens - anything more specific there would help me shape a blended tiered quote.

I attached two quick artifacts: a pricing options summary and the usage export you asked for.

Proposed next steps:
1) You send expected volumes and target $/1M tokens (or budget range).
2) We prepare a blended-step pricing proposal (including suggested committed volume bands and blended rates per route/model).
3) We sync with Procurement (DocuSign/SOW) once the bands look good.

If it helps, I can put together two options: a committed stepped annual plan (best unit econ) and a flexible monthly step plan (lower commitment, slightly higher $/1M).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Renewal/Expansion - pricing follow-up & volume step-ups

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the recap - very helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Current and projected volumes:
  - Current: ~40M tokens/month (gen-only).
  - Q3 ramp (pilot + search): expect ~100M tokens/month by month 3 of expansion.
  - 12-month forward view: we model 1.2B tokens (aggregate across gen + embeddings).

- Routes and model mix:
  - Gen routes: 70% of tokens (assistant + docs).
  - Embeddings (search): 30% of tokens but higher qps and lower avg tokens/req.

- Budget and unit target:
  - Procurement target for blended rate: $450-600 per 1M tokens for the contracted model mix.
  - If committed annual volume >1B tokens, we'd look for $350-450/1M as stretch.

- Constraints / timeline:
  - Procurement prefers a committed-but-stepped approach (easier for budget forecasting).
  - Legal will need standard SOC2 + data residency addendum (we'll send questions through procurement).
  - Target to sign SOW by mid-June to enable Q3 rollout.

Happy to jump back on a short call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Jenna Thompson
CTO | Acme Health
jenna.thompson@acmehealth.com | +1 (650) 555-9988

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Thompson <jenna.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal/Expansion - pricing follow-up & volume step-ups

Jenna -

Appreciate the detail - this is exactly what we need. High-level proposal based on your guidance:

Option A - Committed stepped annual (best unit economics)
- Commitment: 1.2B tokens/year (split per your mix).
- Step bands: 0-250M, 250-750M, 750M-1.2B (monthly smoothing allowed).
- Blended target rate: $380/1M tokens (assumes majority gen usage + embeddings add-on).
- Includes 30 days of premium support and SLA for dedicated capacity fallbacks.

Option B - Flexible monthly step (lower commitment)
- No annual commitment, 12-month pricing bands to encourage step-ups.
- Blended rates: $520/1M tokens (starting), step down to $450/1M at >=500M/month sustained for 2 months.
- Faster onboarding for embeddings route; charged per-embedding request.

Notes on unit economics:
- Gen-heavy usage favors committed pricing because model serving dominates token cost.
- Embeddings volume reduces per-token marginal cost but adds per-request compute; we'll provide a blended estimate in the formal quote.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I'll draft a formal blended quote (shows monthly bands, blended $/1M, and an example monthly invoice at your projected mix).
2) If Option A looks close, I'll loop in Marcus (rev ops) and Laura (legal/pricing) to finalize the discount bands and SOW terms.

Can you confirm if the 1.2B annual figure is a hard target or a planning estimate? That helps us decide how aggressive to price step 3.

Thanks - I’ll aim to have a draft quote by end of day Wednesday.

Best,
Marissa
